changelog:
**Major update introduces a structured, enforceable workflow and improved image candidate selection for designing inspiration/case research-paper figures.**

- Enforces a mandatory visual candidate-board workflow between text planning and image generation, requiring users to compare image candidates before finalizing design decisions.
- Implements strict text/image separation: every reply is either TEXT_ONLY or IMAGE_ONLY—never both.
- Refines the first reply behavior to always show a startup plan, even if the user requests images immediately.
- Expands documentation and examples, adds over 30 new reference and template files; streamlines references to match new workflow.
- Strongly standardizes state tracking in every reply, with explicit current plan, outputs, and next-step suggestions.
- Modernizes integration routes (ChatGPT Images 2.0, Codex $imagegen) and excludes all code-rendered output formats from the workflow.
